description: Calculated (p,n) IAS differential cross sections (mb/sr) of Bauge, Delaroche and Girod, Phys. Rev. C 63, 024607 (2001), Fig. 7 (solid lines), digitized from the published figure. The figure's offsets (x9 at 25 MeV, x3 at 35 MeV) are divided out.
method: Automated tracing of a 400 dpi render of the figure: log axis calibrated on the panel frame (1e-2 to 1e2 mb/sr, 0 to 180 deg), curves traced by a curvature-penalized path search and checked visually against overlays. Expect a few percent accuracy, worse in deep minima.
